title: iTutorGroup to Pay $365000 to Settle EEOC Discriminatory Hiring Suit
supports_claim: The EEOC reported a $365000 settlement and alleged that online application software automatically rejected more than 200 older applicants based on age and sex rules.
limitations: The press release describes allegations and settlement relief; it does not publish a technical audit or establish that a machine-learning model caused the outcome.

title: Testimony of Gary D. Friedman
supports_claim: EEOC-hosted testimony recounts reporting that Amazon built a resume-screening tool in 2014 and scrapped it after identifying bias against female applicants.
limitations: The testimony is not an adjudicative finding and relies partly on reported accounts; it does not establish a deployed decision rate or affected-applicant count.

title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework 1.0
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
supports_claim: NIST describes AI systems as socio-technical systems and organizes risk work around Govern Map Measure and Manage across the lifecycle.
limitations: The framework is voluntary guidance, not a legal classification, certification or proof that a proposed control is effective.

title: AI Act regulatory framework
supports_claim: The European Commission identifies CV-sorting software for recruitment as a high-risk employment use case and describes risk assessment, data quality, logging and human oversight obligations.
limitations: Application dates and implementation guidance can change; the exact provider/deployer role and system classification still require legal review.

title: Law No. 134/2025/QH15 on Artificial Intelligence
supports_claim: The official Vietnamese legal portal publishes the AI Law that defines the governing legal framework to be matched against the product role and deployment context.
limitations: A portal record alone does not determine the exact obligations for this workflow; implementing instruments and product facts must be reviewed together.

title: Decision No. 33/2026/QD-TTg on high-risk AI systems
supports_claim: The official Vietnamese legal portal publishes the decision issuing a high-risk AI systems list that must be matched to the product purpose and deployment role.
limitations: The title and portal metadata are not sufficient to classify this product; counsel must inspect the full list and current implementing guidance.
